statement.zh: 查加尔巴扎尔 1936 年第二季记录了聚落语境，并含哈布尔地区调查，见 Mallowan 1937（Iraq 4/2）。
statement.en: At Chagar Bazar, the 1936 second campaign recorded settlement contexts, with related Habur regional survey, as documented in Mallowan 1937 (Iraq 4/2).
